title: Reading Tanker Tea Leaves
summary:
IEA paints lukewarm outlook for crude oil tankers
Every year around this time, the International Energy Agency (IEA) publishes their Medium Term Oil Market Report. The report includes the customary oil supply and demand forecasts and refinery dynamics. Most interesting for us in the tanker industry is their detailed discussion of the crude oil trade flows.
